purpose: Preview-only brighter variants of D 伙伴大合照; no game source, active assets or builds changed.

variants.name: 清透天蓝
variants.direction: PALETTE D1 — SKY BLUE / CLOUD WHITE. Clear luminous cyan-sky blue background, like a fresh sunny sky; pure-white fluffy clouds along the bottom. The broad arch behind the cast uses light turquoise, lemon and white, restrained. Title snow-white plush letters with cobalt outline and a tiny coral accent. Loading track white with bright sky-blue/cobalt fill; dark navy lettering. This is the freshest, clearest, most open-air version. Vibrant blue background but sufficient value contrast with the bear; use a pale cloud/arch immediately behind the bear. NOT muted blue-grey.
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE polished portrait mobile game loading-screen design variant, 9:19.5 aspect ratio, ideally 1080x2340. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing “伙伴大合照” design for “泡泡小队”. Keep the same recognizable five plush flowerpot companions and cheerful triangular group-photo arrangement: cobalt-blue bear largest center-back with round cream inner ears, creamy double-lobed muzzle and brown nose; orange sleepy capybara left; lime green frog right; smaller pink floppy rabbit and white kitten in front. Keep the felt pots, green leaves, embroidered motifs, expressive friendly faces and floating translucent soap bubbles. Keep the title exactly “泡泡小队” prominent across the upper region, but update its accent colors to suit this version. No new characters. Preserve identifiable character colors.

PRIMARY CHANGE: make this fresh, BRIGHT, crisp, modern and lively rather than antique or faded. Strong clean local colors, neutral-white studio daylight, vivid blue bear and green frog, white kitten genuinely white. Fine soft tactile fur must remain very visible; fresh clean plush toys, not glossy plastic. Remove the yellow/sepia cast, dusty desaturation, brown shadows, haze and aged textile appearance from the reference. Background is clean smooth color; fuzzy fibers belong on plush characters and felt props, not over the entire image. Soft contact shadows for depth, no heavy shadows. Never clip highlights into lost fur detail. Keep composition clear and playful, no dense clutter.

LAYOUT: top 7% quiet space; title roughly 12–25%; group portrait approx 31–76%; keep all five faces and recognizable pots visible. Bottom 20% clean bright surface for loading UI, with no characters behind text. Include a tasteful rounded shallow progress bar at 36% and text exactly “加载中… 36%”, visually separate from the portrait. Footer MUST replace the old short slogan with complete crisp Chinese text, centered, with exact wording and line breaks:
《健康游戏忠告》
抵制不良游戏，拒绝盗版游戏。
注意自我保护，谨防受骗上当。
适度游戏益脑，沉迷游戏伤身。
合理安排时间，享受健康生活。
Make footer small but readable dark colored text. Leave comfortable bottom margin. No phone chrome, no age badges, no developer logos, no comparison label such as D1 inside the artwork. Full-bleed complete finished mockup.

variants.name: 明亮珊瑚粉
variants.direction: PALETTE D2 — BRIGHT CORAL PINK / CLEAN WHITE / MINT. Keep the reference's pink family but make it decisively fresher: luminous watermelon-coral pink upper background fading to a very pale cool blush, not peach or beige. Large title clean white with saturated coral-pink edge, small mint leaves. Broad arch uses clean mint, white and light pink. White fluffy cloud field below, no yellow cast. Loading track white, lively mint-teal fill, dark berry lettering. A joyful candy-shop group portrait, bright and sweet without nostalgic dusty-rose toning.

variants.name: 暖阳奶油色
variants.direction: PALETTE D4 — LUMINOUS LEMON YELLOW / WHITE / SKY BLUE. Sunny buttercup/lemon yellow upper background and clean near-white lower surface, rich and bright without orange/brown warmth or sepia. A broad sky-blue and white arch behind the five friends gives color contrast. Title bright white plush with saturated sky-blue edge and tiny fresh green leaves. Loading bar white with cobalt-blue fill, navy lettering. Modern cheerful sunshine toy advertisement, clean neutral-white light on fur even on the yellow background; no beige haze, ivory-yellow cat, brown felt or old paper look. Keep yellow strongest in the backdrop and all whites clean.
